description: Of the eight letters concerning Zelinski, three are letters from Maria Chabot to Edward Chrichton concerning a debt, Sept. 12 – Oct. 5, 1964; four are letters from Chabot to Georgeanna Wight, of which three concern the break in Chabot's relationship to Zelinski, July 21-29, 1961, and one concerns Wight's application to enter a nursing home, Jan. 22, 1962; and one letter from Wight to Chabot concerning the break in the Chabot/Zelinski relationship and a transcription of it.
title: Maria Chabot correspondence regarding Irene Zelinski
